description: Store + Avatar + Certificates backend modules, plus the full Next.js 14 frontend. Backend: AvatarsModule (GET /avatar/items), StoreModule (POST /store/purchase, POST /store/purchase/confirm/:id, GET /store/transactions), CertificatesModule (POST /certificates, GET /certificates/:id), plus BullMQ worker for background jobs. Frontend: Next.js App Router with all 7 components ported from vanilla HTML, connecting to /api/* endpoints. Depends on FEAT-001 (infra) and FEAT-002 (auth+social API) being complete.
steps: Create apps/api/src/avatars/ module. avatars.service.ts: findAllItems() returns all avatar_items sorted by isPremium asc, price asc. avatars.controller.ts: GET /avatar/items (@Public()). avatars.module.ts.

Create apps/api/src/store/ module. store.service.ts: purchase(userId, dto: PurchaseDto): find item, check not already owned (UserInventory), create Transaction with paymentStatus='pending', return transaction with QRIS simulation data {transactionId, amount, qrisPayload:'SIMULATED_QRIS_'+transactionId}. confirmPurchase(transactionId, userId): find transaction, verify ownership, set paymentStatus='completed', upsert UserInventory row. getTransactions(userId): return user's transactions with item details. store.controller.ts: GET /store/transactions (JWT), POST /store/purchase (JWT), POST /store/purchase/confirm/:transactionId (JWT). store.module.ts.
Create apps/api/src/store/dto/purchase.dto.ts: itemId @IsUUID @IsNotEmpty.

Create apps/api/src/certificates/ module. certificates.service.ts: create(postId, userId): verify post exists and userId owns it, create Certificate row with imagePath=null (image generation is async via worker). findOne(id): return certificate. certificates.controller.ts: POST /certificates (JWT, body:{postId}), GET /certificates/:id (@Public()). certificates.module.ts.

Create apps/api/src/worker/ BullMQ worker. worker.module.ts: BullModule.registerQueue({name:'certificates'}), registers CertificateProcessor. certificate.processor.ts: @Processor('certificates') class with @Process('generate') method — receives job data {certificateId, postContent, username}, generates a simple SVG string (same design as Tahap 1 cert card), saves to STORAGE_PATH/certificates/{id}.svg, updates Certificate.imagePath. worker.ts entrypoint: NestFactory.createApplicationContext(WorkerModule).

Create apps/api/src/certificates/certificate.queue.ts: injects @InjectQueue('certificates') Bull queue, exposes addGenerateJob(certId, postContent, username). CertificatesService calls this after creating the DB row.
Register AvatarsModule, StoreModule, CertificatesModule in AppModule.

Create apps/web/package.json: name @unlinked/web, dependencies: next@14, react@18, react-dom@18, typescript, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, @types/react, @types/react-dom, @types/node, axios, js-cookie, @types/js-cookie, html2canvas, canvas-confetti, @types/canvas-confetti, lucide-react. Scripts: dev, build, start, lint.
Create apps/web/next.config.ts: output:'standalone' for Docker, images.domains:['192.168.1.20'], env:{NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}.

Create apps/web/tailwind.config.ts: content ['./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'], theme.extend.colors: {primary:'#F5C542', accent:'#F57C00', navy:'#172B4D', background:'#FAFAFA'}, fontFamily: {display:['Nunito','sans-serif'], body:['Inter','sans-serif']}.

Create apps/web/Dockerfile: multi-stage. Stage 1 (deps): node:20-alpine, copy package*.json, npm ci. Stage 2 (builder): copy deps, copy src, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL build arg, npm run build. Stage 3 (runner): node:20-alpine, copy .next/standalone, .next/static, public. ENV NODE_ENV=production PORT=3000. CMD node server.js.
Create apps/web/src/lib/types.ts: TypeScript interfaces matching all API response shapes — User, Profile, Post, Reaction, AvatarItem, Transaction, Certificate, PaginatedResponse<T>, AuthResponse.

Create apps/web/src/lib/api.ts: axios instance with baseURL=process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, request interceptor adds Authorization: Bearer {token from localStorage/cookie}. Exports typed functions: authRegister, authLogin, authMe, getPosts(page), createPost(data), toggleReaction(postId,type), getReactions(postId), getProfile(username), updateProfile(data), getAvatarItems, purchase(itemId), confirmPurchase(transactionId), getTransactions, createCertificate(postId), getCertificate(id).

Create apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx: root layout with <html lang='id'>, Google Fonts (Nunito + Inter via next/font/google), Tailwind base styles, metadata {title:'unlinked+', description:'No Flex. Just Human.'}.

Create apps/web/src/app/page.tsx: port of index.html landing page as a Next.js Server Component. Sections: hero with waitlist form (client island), certificate preview (client island), feature cards, manifesto, footer. Same color palette and copy as Tahap 1. The waitlist form is a 'use client' Client Component that calls authRegister and stores JWT.

Create apps/web/src/app/app/page.tsx: 'use client' page. 5-tab shell with BottomNav. Renders active tab content: Feed, Create, Avatar, Shop, Profile. On mount: check JWT in localStorage — if missing redirect to /. Manages activeTab state.

Create apps/web/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: 'use client', 5 buttons (Beranda/Feed, Spill/Create, Avatar, Toko/Shop, Profil/Profile), active tab highlighted with primary color, fixed bottom bar matching Tahap 1 design.

Create apps/web/src/components/FailFeed.tsx: 'use client'. Fetches GET /api/posts?page=1 on mount and on scroll near bottom (infinite scroll via IntersectionObserver). Renders PostCard list. PostCard shows: avatar SVG inline, username, level badge, category badge, content, relative timestamp, ReactionBar, 'Buat Sertifikat' button.

Create apps/web/src/components/ReactionBar.tsx: 'use client'. Props: postId, initialReactions, initialUserReactions. Buttons: 🫂 Puk-Puk, 😂 Ngakak Maaf, 🤝 Sama Banget with counts. On click: call toggleReaction API, update local state optimistically.

Create apps/web/src/components/AvatarBuilder.tsx: 'use client'. Inline SVG rendering (port SVG paths from js/avatar-builder.js). Character selector (4 cards), accessory list (5 rows with free/premium status). On save: call PATCH /users/me with {avatarConfig:{character,accessories}}.

Create apps/web/src/components/CertificateModal.tsx: 'use client'. Opens when 'Buat Sertifikat' clicked. Calls POST /certificates, renders cert card div with same layout as Tahap 1, uses html2canvas to download PNG.

Create apps/web/src/components/ShopModal.tsx and QRISModal.tsx: 'use client'. ShopModal shows avatar items grid. QRISModal shows simulated QRIS SVG, 'Konfirmasi Bayar' button calls POST /store/purchase/confirm/:id, fires canvas-confetti on success.
Create apps/web/src/components/AuthModal.tsx: 'use client'. Register/Login form modal. On submit: call authRegister or authLogin, store JWT in localStorage, close modal, reload auth state.
acceptance_criteria: GET /avatar/items returns array of 5 seeded avatar items
POST /store/purchase creates a pending transaction and returns qrisPayload
POST /store/purchase/confirm/:id sets transaction to completed and adds item to user inventory
GET /certificates/:id returns certificate with imagePath (may be null until worker processes it)
http://192.168.1.20 loads Next.js landing page with correct unlinked+ branding
http://192.168.1.20/app loads 5-tab app shell, bottom nav works
FailFeed fetches and displays posts from /api/posts
ReactionBar toggles reactions and updates counts without page reload
AvatarBuilder renders SVG avatars and saves to backend via PATCH /users/me
ShopModal + QRISModal complete a purchase flow end-to-end (pending → confirmed → inventory)
verification: docker compose up --build — all 7 services healthy
curl http://192.168.1.20/api/avatar/items | python3 -m json.tool — returns JSON array
Open http://192.168.1.20 in browser — landing page renders with yellow hero, certificate preview, feature cards
Open http://192.168.1.20/app in browser — all 5 tabs work, feed loads posts from API
cd apps/api && npm run test — all unit tests pass
